approved_question: In what month did Russia's Central Bank begin the second rate-hike round, described as starting in late July 2024 after borrowing accelerated in (6)?
reason: The document says borrowing accelerated by Q2 2024, leading to a second round starting in late July 2024; October is the later record-rate endpoint.
